subject: Fwd: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge – cross-functional review
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pinebridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering team has a hard requirement for our inference path: any inference called from our customer-facing flow needs a 95th/99th strategy that keeps tail latency under 100ms for text generation at our expected steady-state QPS (~120 req/s). We know this is aggressive, but this is the gating item for our pilot launch in Q1.

Concretely we are asking for:
- A temporary contractual commitment to a p95 <= 100ms for production traffic for three months while we validate volume and optimizations.
- Dedicated capacity (or equivalent isolation) during peak hours.
- Telemetry access (traces + token-level latency breakdowns) and a mutual action plan for regressions.

We are prepared to accept a higher unit price during the pilot and to sign a short addendum. Can your team confirm feasibility and an estimated cost uplift? I can join a short working session if helpful.

Attached: pba_slo_request_form.pdf (filled)

Best,
Elena Morris
CTO, Pinebridge Analytics
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge – need cross-functional input

Team — forwarding Pinebridge's ask. High level asks: sub-100ms p95 for ~120 QPS production traffic for a 3-month pilot, dedicated capacity during peaks, telemetry access. They will accept a price uplift.

I need quick answers to:
1) Is this operationally feasible without a long infra project?
2) If feasible, what is the recommended approach (dedicated pool vs. autoscale + model variant)?
3) Rough cost uplift estimate and margin impact for sales to use during negotiation.
4) Legal redline constraints we need for a temporary SLO addendum.

Please reply with concrete asks/owners. I can set up a 30m working session tomorrow if needed.

Thanks — Sean
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge – product take

Sean / team — product thoughts:
- Sub-100ms p95 at 120 QPS is feasible only under certain constraints: shorter sequence budgets, aggressive KV/prefix caching, and dedicated inference capacity (shared pools will add jitter).
- Short-term playbook: provision a dedicated pool of optimized instances (mixed low-latency GPUs), enforce a request contract: max prompt length and response token cap, and pin to a quantized, lower-latency model variant we already host.
- We'll also require work on prompt templates and token limits from Pinebridge to keep variability low.
- Telemetry: we can expose token-level latency traces and p95 dashboards for the pilot; product and observability will need 2 weeks to configure dashboards + alerting.

Open questions for infra: how long to provision a dedicated pool (lead time) and approximated cost numbers so Sales can finalize the deal.

Recommend: 3-month pilot with weekly quality checkpoints, rollback triggers (if p95 > 150ms for >2 consecutive days we fall back to standard routing), and an explicit ops on-call window.

— Grace
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-16T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge – infra feasibility

Quick feasibility notes:
- Dedicated pool: we can provision a reserved pool in the customer's region. Estimated lead time: 4 business days for capacity carving if we have spare inventory; 10–12 business days if we need to reprovision from other racks.
- Cost uplift: ballpark +45–70% on per-token cost for the dedicated low-latency configuration (depends on model and instance sizing). See attached capacity_cost_estimate.xlsx (stub) for a worked example at 120 QPS with 1.5k tokens per minute.
- Autoscaling: we can keep autoscale but lock min instances to the dedicated pool to reduce cold-starts; will require a temporary override in the orchestration layer. Ops staffing: need to assign a runbook and 24/7 on-call rotation for the first 30 days.
- Telemetry: we can stream traces to a Pinebridge-managed workspace and provide read-only dashboard links; needs NDA clauses covered (legal).

I'll open SUP-2034 to track provisioning and capacity ops. Assigning initial owners: infra provisioning -> dev_patel, runbook -> karthik_iyer, telemetry onboarding -> marissa_cole (CS/observability).

— Dev
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-17T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Sub-100ms commitment for Pinebridge – legal redlines

Thanks — legal notes:
- We can support a temporary SLO addendum for a fixed pilot term (3 months). We must avoid hard financial SLA credits for a short pilot; propose a remediation plan + operational escalation instead (e.g., free run-hours or discounted uplift for a defined window).
- Need explicit acceptance criteria: how p95 is measured (production ingress, sampling method, rolling 24h windows), and agreed rollback/fallback triggers.
- Data access: telemetry read-only links to a Pinebridge workspace ok, but cross-account access requires documented scoping and an IP allowlist (security to sign off).
- I attached proposed_sla_redline.docx with a clause for pilot-limited commitment and a termination for convenience after the pilot.

Next steps: Sales to confirm pricing uplift and whether Pinebridge will accept remediation-in-kind instead of SLA credits. Finance should sign off on any pricing exceptions.

— Laura
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Decision & next steps — Pinebridge SLO pilot (PBA-20261015)

Thanks everyone — summary and owners: 

Decision: greenlight a 3-month pilot with a temporary p95 <= 100ms commitment subject to these conditions: dedicated capacity in US region, prompt/response token caps, weekly quality checkpoints, and explicit fallback triggers. Legal accepts remediation-in-kind approach (discounted uplift credits) rather than monetary SLA credits for this pilot.

Owners & actions: 
- Infra provisioning & SUP ticket: dev_patel (open SUP-2034, target provisioning within 5 business days if inventory available).
- Runbook & on-call: karthik_iyer (publish runbook + ops rota).
- Observability & telemetry links: marissa_cole (deliver dashboard + read-only workspace by Day 10).
- Product guardrails & model pinning: grace_oconnor (define allowed model variant + token caps).
- Legal doc + DocuSign: laura_bennett (prepare addendum; send DocuSign template).
- Sales: sean_gallagher to confirm final price uplift with finance and send NDA/addendum. Deal record: https://app.redwood.com/deals/PBA-20261015.

Immediate asks: Dev, can you attach the cost worksheet and an estimated monthly uplift range by EOD today so I can lock pricing? Laura, please share the final addendum draft and DocuSign link when ready. Marissa, loop Pinebridge's infra contact (elena.morris@pinebridge.ai) for telemetry onboarding.

I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Pinebridge once legal sends the addendum.

— Sean
